Prevention: Destroy rotten fruit from infected trees (field sanitation).
This involves collecting and burning fallen fruit.
Purchase grafted plants from the ministry.
Monitoring: Search among the cracks in the trunk and branches and among the leaves.
This is especially important at fruit set.
Check young fruits for eggs (white and in groups near the stalk)
Take action if eggs are seen.
However, fruit is marketable even if infested
Cut mature fruit in halves to check for infestation
Direct Control: Put a grease band around the base of the tree to prevent the weevils climbing (they are not strong flyers
Restrictions: Rotate chemicals to prevent buildup of resistance (change chemicals regularly)
Protective equipment should be worn when handling pesticides
Spray the trunk and branches with
